capabilities: Render dashboards from a profile.json defining layout and panes
Display 11 widget types including tables, kanban boards, heatmaps, forms and stat sparklines
Rewrite note frontmatter via action buttons and board drag with undo
Register custom widgets from companion plugins via the window.pinax API
Export and import profiles as JSON bundles or https URLs
extras: Trust toggles (web embeds, command buttons, note writing) are off by default and scoped per profile; no telemetry or network requests except user-configured https iframes and URL imports; install via BRAT beta; community profiles at sphragis-oss/pinax-profiles; some helm-profile widgets are desktop-only and degrade to placeholders on mobile.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to assemble a live dashboard of tables, boards and metrics over existing notes without writing custom code.

relations.evidence: Optional companion: the Terminal community plugin (polyipseity/obsidian-terminal) so command buttons open an integrated terminal pane
Seeded from the working command-center ("The Helm") Obsidian plugin; its SRE dashboard survives, config-driven

summary: Config-driven dashboard framework that renders tables, kanban boards, heatmaps, forms and stats over vault notes from a profile.json file.
